title: Herb eggs in tomatoes
summary: Herb eggs in tomatoes is a middle eastern dinner built around medium eggs and chopped tomatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Herb eggs in tomatoes. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add medium eggs and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and chopped tomatoes.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until onions is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Herb eggs in tomatoes before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Herb eggs in tomatoes.
